python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("src/codegen_support/runtime/io/file_scheme.rs")
s = p.read_text()
old = '''    emitter.label(&no_url);
    emitter.instruction("mov x9, #0");
    abi::emit_store_reg_to_symbol(emitter, "x9", "_rt_path_url", 0);            // an ordinary path names itself'''
new = '''    emitter.label(&no_url);
    // NOT x9: `emit_store_reg_to_symbol` resolves the symbol address THROUGH x9 on AArch64, so a
    // value parked there is overwritten by the address before the store and the slot receives the
    // address itself — which the next diagnostic then prints as bytes.
    emitter.instruction("mov x10, #0");
    abi::emit_store_reg_to_symbol(emitter, "x10", "_rt_path_url", 0);           // an ordinary path names itself'''
assert s.count(old) == 1, ("convert", s.count(old))
s = s.replace(old, new)

old = '''            emitter.instruction("mov x0, x10");                                 // php names what the program wrote
            emitter.instruction("mov x9, #0");
            abi::emit_store_reg_to_symbol(emitter, "x9", "_rt_path_url", 0);    // consumed'''
new = '''            emitter.instruction("mov x0, x10");                                 // php names what the program wrote
            emitter.instruction("mov x11, #0");                                 // x9 is the symbol scratch: see `emit_convert_aarch64`
            abi::emit_store_reg_to_symbol(emitter, "x11", "_rt_path_url", 0);   // consumed'''
assert s.count(old) == 1, ("diag name", s.count(old))
s = s.replace(old, new)
p.write_text(s)
print("x9 clobber fixed")
PY
CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=false cargo build 2>&1 | grep -E '^error' -A 6 | head -20; echo BUILD_DONE: x9 clobber fixed BUILD_DONE
